scope: Current declared references, development tasks and design profiles; no new physics runs in this website update.
counting_rules: Original 14 plus ten additional independent tasks. Parent packages and aliases are not extra tasks.
Published task materials include one experimental Sokoban witness with task_success=null.
The eight design profiles are separate from the 24 implemented task entries.
Reference release, owner approval, measured physical success and formal benchmark admission are distinct.
